description: This file contains configuration and setup functions for VXLAN tunneling protocols in a network configuration system. It includes functions to set up VXLAN and VXLAN6 peers, initialize configuration options, and tear down tunnels, primarily for OpenWRT or similar Linux-based network systems.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup_peer
methods.description: Sets up a VXLAN peer by appending entries to the bridge's forwarding database based on peer configuration.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_setup
methods.description: General function to initialize VXLAN tunnel settings and add necessary configuration data.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup
methods.description: Sets up a VXLAN tunnel with specified IP addresses and peer configuration.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_setup
methods.description: Sets up a VXLAN6 tunnel with specified IPv6 addresses and peer configuration.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_init_config
methods.description: Initializes common configuration options for VXLAN tunnels.
